scripts.text:
[Han]
There must be a ton of monsters
attacking the center of Prontera.
***
scripts.translation:
[韓]
普隆德拉中心一定正遭到大量魔物的襲擊。
***

scripts.text:
[Han]
My family...My friends...
They're all there...
I must protect them...
But...I have an even more important
job to do here...
scripts.translation:
[韓]
家人...朋友...都在那裡...我必須保護他們...
可我在這裡還有更重要的任務...

scripts.text:
[Han]
I, scientist Doyeon, can do it.
I can obliterate that dirty source place,
ceaselessly spawning the monsters...
That's why I'm protecting him.
***
scripts.translation:
[韓]
我相信科學家道淵能做到，摧毀那個不斷湧出魔物的骯髒源頭...
所以我要保護她。
***

scripts.text:
[Han]
Protecting him and destroying this fortress
is what ultimately protects my family
and friends.
scripts.translation:
[韓]
保護她，摧毀這座要塞，才是真正保護我的家人和朋友。

scripts.text:
[Doek]
Can this scientist you're seeing here
really protect Prontera?
Can she?
Do you believe so?
scripts.translation:
[德克]
眼前這個科學家，真的能保護普隆德拉？
她能做到嗎？你相信？

scripts.text:
[Doek]
Honestly, I don't...
But...
scripts.translation:
[德克]
說實話，我不太相信...
但是...

scripts.text:
[Doek]
All my loved ones were...
...by those monsters....
scripts.translation:
[德克]
我所有的親人都...
...被那些魔物奪走了...

scripts.text:
[Doek]
This is the last hope I can have...
This is the last.
So please help me.
Help Doyeon...
scripts.translation:
[德克]
這是我最後的希望...最後的希望。
所以請幫幫我，幫幫道淵...

scripts.text:
- And then, she remained silent -
- for quite a while. -
scripts.translation: - 隨後，她沉默了很久。-

scripts.text:
- It's full of items
so you can't proceed to conversation. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品欄已滿，無法繼續對話。-

scripts.text:
- You should be level 145 or higher
to proceed. -
scripts.translation: - 你需要達到145級才能繼續。-

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I'm a scientist
living in Prontera.
I'm just an ordinary scientist
teaching children and doing research.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
我是住在普隆德拉的普通科學家，平時教孩子們知識，做些研究。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
But now...the life at least as I know it
has become shattered.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
但現在...我熟悉的生活已經徹底破碎。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Thanks to this fortress
looking like a huge trash can,
our village has turned into a trash heap
that doesn't even decay.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
都怪那座像大垃圾桶一樣的要塞，把我們的村子變成了連腐爛都不會的垃圾堆。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Buildings fall down,
people keep dying out...
I have to wonder what the nobility and soldiers at the Prontera Palace
are up to when things are like this.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
房屋接連倒塌，人們不斷死去...
都這樣了，普隆德拉王宮裡的貴族和士兵到底在幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
A ton of undead monsters kept swarming about
from that entrance seen behind me
as if the sap monster spits out the sap.
They kept coming out
no matter how many were killed.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
大量不死魔物從我身後的入口湧出，就像樹液怪不斷吐出樹液一樣。
無論消滅多少，都沒完沒了。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I suppose the monsters are being made up
inside the fortress.
My guess is that if we can defeat their ringleader in the fortress,
the monsters will get away
and Prontera will become stabilized.
***
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
我懷疑魔物是要塞裡製造的。
如果能打倒裡面的首領，魔物也許就會消失，普隆德拉也能安定下來。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
So I really wanted to enter the fortress
but couldn't find any entrance.
I studied day and night
and finally located it.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
我想進要塞，卻始終找不到入口。
日夜研究，總算找到了。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To enter the fortress,
the warp should be activated.
To do so, a lot of magic
is indispensable!
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
進入要塞得先啟動傳送門，為此需要大量魔力！

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
And then...I've been preparing
a lot of magic necessary for the warp.
Now I could use a warrior
who can shatter the fortress
and bring peace to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
所以...我一直在積攢傳送門所需的魔力。
現在只缺一位勇士，去摧毀要塞，讓普隆德拉恢復和平。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I'm a scientist
living in Prontera.
I'm just an ordinary scientist
teaching children and doing research.
And then...things came up
in Prontera all of a sudden....
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
我是住在普隆德拉的普通科學家，平時教孩子們知識，做些研究。
可突然間，普隆德拉出了事...

scripts.text: About Sky Fortress
scripts.translation: 關於天空要塞

scripts.text: Enter the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation: 進入天空要塞

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

must not be enough.
***

three days to collect magic.

To enter the fortress,
the warp should be activated.
To do so,
the -Dungeon Pass-
is indispensable!
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
進入要塞得先啟動傳送門，為此必須有“地下城通行證”！

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
And then...I've been preparing
a lot of magic necessary for the warp.
Now I could use a warrior
who can shatter the fortress
and bring peace to Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
所以...我一直在積攢傳送門所需的魔力。
現在只缺一位勇士，去摧毀要塞，讓普隆德拉恢復和平。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I'm a scientist
living in Prontera.
I teach children and perform research activities.
But it has become
so dangerous there,
so I moved in here.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
我是普隆德拉的科學家，平時教孩子們知識，做些研究。
可那裡實在太危險，我才搬到這裡。

scripts.text: About Sky Fortress
scripts.translation: 關於天空要塞

scripts.text: Enter the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation: 進入天空要塞

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
But now...my normal life
has become shattered.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
但現在...我平靜的生活已經徹底破碎。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Thanks to this fortress
looking like a huge trash can,
our village has turned into a trash heap
that doesn't even decay.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
都怪那座像大垃圾桶一樣的要塞，把我們的村子變成了連腐爛都不會的垃圾堆。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Buildings fall down,
people keep dying out...
I have to wonder what the nobility and soldiers at the Prontera Palace
are up to when things are like this.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
房屋接連倒塌，人們不斷死去...
都這樣了，普隆德拉王宮裡的貴族和士兵到底在幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
A ton of undead monsters kept swarming about
as if the sap monster spits out the sap.
They kept coming out
no matter how many were killed.
***
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
大量不死魔物不斷湧出，就像樹液怪吐出樹液一樣。
無論消滅多少，都沒完沒了。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I suppose the monsters are being made up
inside the fortress.
My guess is that if we can defeat their ringleader in the fortress,
the monsters will go away
and Prontera will become stabilized.
***
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
我懷疑魔物是要塞裡製造的。
如果能打倒裡面的首領，魔物也許就會消失，普隆德拉也能安定下來。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
So I wanted to enter the fortress
but couldn't find any entrance.
I studied day and night
and finally located it.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
我想進要塞，卻始終找不到入口。
日夜研究，總算找到了。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To enter the fortress,
the warp should be activated.
To do so, a lot of magic
is indispensable!
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
進入要塞得先啟動傳送門，為此需要大量魔力！

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
And then...I've been preparing
a lot of magic necessary for the warp.
Now I could use a warrior
who can shatter the fortress
and bring peace to Prontera.
That's why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
所以...我一直在積攢傳送門所需的魔力。
現在只缺一位勇士，去摧毀要塞，讓普隆德拉恢復和平。
這就是我守在這裡的原因。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To operate the warp,
a lot of magic is required.
Don't forget to bring me
the -Dungeon Pass-.
That's the only way to open
the warp to the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
啟動傳送門需要大量魔力。
別忘了帶來“地下城通行證”，只有這樣才能開啟通往天空要塞的傳送門。

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Show the -Dungeon Pass-.
scripts.translation: 出示“地下城通行證”

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Don't forget to bring me
the -Dungeon Pass-.
Enter the Sky Fortress
and help us save
the invaded Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
別忘了帶來“地下城通行證”，進入天空要塞，幫我們拯救淪陷的普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I don't think this works
without the -Dungeon Pass-.
I can't open the warp without it.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
沒有“地下城通行證”可不行，我沒法開啟傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Oh! Where did you
get the -Dungeon Pass-?
This item is enough
to open the warp.
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
哦！你從哪兒弄到的“地下城通行證”？
有這個就能開啟傳送門了。

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text: Activate the warp.
scripts.translation: 啟動傳送門

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Are you not going
to help Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
你不想幫助普隆德拉嗎？

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
There! I opened the warp
to the Sky Fortress!
The warp will be activated
only for a limited period of time.
Step inside it, quick!
scripts.translation:
[科學家 道淵]
好了！通往天空要塞的傳送門打開了！
只能維持一會兒，快進去！
